title: PagedResultOfContent
description: A model containing a collection of Content pieces and metadata about their position in a larger result list.

hasMoreResults.description: A value indicating whether the larger result set has more results.

pageIndex.description: The index of the page reflected by the collection.

pageSize.description: The size of the page relfected by the collection.

skip.description: A value indicating how many of the previous values in the larger result set were omitted.

take.description: The number of records retrieved from larger result set.

totalCount.description: The total number of records in the larger result set.

items.description: The records retrieved from the larger result set.

allOf.description: A piece of content represents a container for files and metadata in the Zywave system. Can be maintained by an agency or Zywave.

id.description: The unique Zywave identifier for the content.

fileId.description: The unique identifier for the lastest ContentFile for the content.

fileName.description: The name of the lastest ContentFile for the content.

thumbnailUrl.description: Thumbnail image source for the content.

tagNames.description: A list of tags that describes what the content is.

ContentInfo.description: ContentInfo represents the editable properties of a piece of content.

title.description: The title of the piece of content.

description.description: The description of the piece of content.

clientDescription.description: The description clients see for the piece of content.

file.description: The file that will be associated to the content.

createdDateTime.description: The date the content was created

updatedDateTime.description: The date the file was last edited

metadata.description: Additional dynamic information about the content.
